VerificationResult.description: Canonical Verification result set from Section 1/Section 15.

VerificationMode.description: Reference verification modes from Section 7/15. Kept extensible because the frozen specification describes modes but does not prohibit additional implementation-specific modes.

VerificationIndependenceLevel.description: Canonical independence levels used by AOF verification semantics.

EscalationReason.description: Formal escalation reason identifier. Frozen specification does not define a universal closed set.

OutcomeStatus.description: Outcome status remains extensible because the frozen specification does not define one closed universal OutcomeStatus enum.

VerificationIndependence.description: Machine-readable VerificationIndependence representation. Appendix E.22 names the type but does not freeze one closed universal representation.
